repos.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

aiSummary.summary: 该项目提供一份基于Andrej Karpathy观察的Claude Code行为改进指南，聚焦四大原则：思考先行、简洁优先、精准修改、目标驱动执行，旨在帮助LLM在编写代码时避免误判、过度抽象、无意义改动，并提升代码质量与可维护性。
aiSummary.summary_en: A project offering CLAUDE.md for code improvement
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要提升LLM代码生成质量的开发者与研究者

repos.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.

aiSummary.summary: Claude-Mem 是一个为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，能够自动捕获编码会话中的工具使用情况，通过 AI 压缩生成语义摘要，并在后续会话中注入相关上下文。该插件支持多语言界面，提供一键安装功能，可与 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 和 OpenCode 等多种开发工具集成，帮助开发者在不同会话间保持项目知识的连续性。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures coding session activities, compresses them with AI, and injects relevant context into future sessions for continuity.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要跨会话保持上下文的 AI 辅助编程场景
aiSummary.useCase_en: Maintains context continuity across coding sessions by automatically capturing and compressing session data for future r

repos.description: Self-evolving agent: grows skill tree from 3.3K-line seed, achieving full system control with 6x less token consumption

aiSummary.summary: GenericAgent 是一种自适应代理，自适应技能树，高效轻量，适合自动化任务。
aiSummary.summary_en: Self-evolving agent with minimal codebase that grows skills autonomously through task crystallization.
aiSummary.useCase_en: Enables LLMs to autonomously control local systems (browser, terminal, etc.) with self-evolving skills.

aiSummary.summary: Voicebox 是本地化开源语音合成工作室，支持几秒音频克隆声纹，提供 5 引擎、23 语言的 TTS，支持音高、混响、延迟等后处理效果，提供多轨道时间线编辑，完整隐私保护，并提供 REST API 供集成使用。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source voice synthesis studio for local voice cloning, speech generation, and multi-voice projects with 5 TTS engines and 23 languages.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要本地私密语音合成、多语言配音、多轨道音频制作的开发者和内容创作者。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Local voice cloning and speech generation for privacy-focused applications and creative projects

repos.description: An open source template for building cloud agents.

aiSummary.summary: Open Agents 是一个基于 Vercel 的开源参考应用，提供 Web UI、持久化工作流、沙盒 VM 三层架构，支持聊天驱动的编码代理。代理与沙盒分离，代理通过工具与沙盒交互，沙盒可独立休眠/恢复。功能包括文件、搜索、shell、任务、技能、网页工具，支持多步持久化执行、流式输出、取消、自动提交 PR，支持语音输入。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source reference app for building and running background coding agents on Vercel with web UI, agent runtime, and sandbox orchestration.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要在云端自动化代码生成、修改并直接推送到 GitHub 的场景
aiSummary.useCase_en: Build cloud agents that perform coding tasks through a chat interface with file manipulation, shell commands, and reposi

repos.description: Fast and accurate AI powered file content types detection

aiSummary.summary: Magika是Google开源的AI驱动文件类型检测工具，基于深度学习模型实现毫秒级高精度文件识别。该模型仅几MB大小，在200+文件类型上达到约99%准确率，已在Gmail、Drive等Google产品中大规模部署，每周处理数千亿样本。
aiSummary.summary_en: Magika is an AI-powered file type detection tool that uses a tiny deep‑learning model to identify over 200 content types with ~99% accuracy in milliseconds.
aiSummary.useCase: 文件类型识别、安全扫描、内容分类
aiSummary.useCase_en: Accurately classify file content for security, compliance, and content‑policy scanning at scale.

aiSummary.summary: WhatsApp CLI提供消息管理功能，支持同步、搜索和发送。
aiSummary.summary_en: wacli is a Go‑based CLI for WhatsApp that syncs chats, offers offline search, and lets users send messages and media via the WhatsApp Web protocol.
aiSummary.useCase: 用于WhatsApp消息管理，支持同步、搜索和发送功能。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Command‑line tool for users to authenticate, sync, search, and send WhatsApp messages without a GUI.

repos.description: Knowledge Engine for AI Agent Memory in 6 lines of code

aiSummary.summary: Cognee 是一个基于向量检索、图数据库和认知科学的开源知识引擎，提供持久化记忆、学习代理、跨代理知识共享及可插拔的 LLM 接口，支持快速上下文管理。
aiSummary.summary_en: Cognee enhances AI agent memory through integrated search and learning.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要长期记忆、上下文感知的 AI 代理系统。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Cognee enhances AI agent memory by integrating search and learning.

repos.description: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding

aiSummary.summary: DFlash 是一个专为投机采样（Speculative Decoding）设计的轻量级块扩散模型（Block Diffusion Model）。它通过高效的并行草稿生成技术，显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理速度。该项目支持多种主流模型（如 Qwen、Llama、Kimi 等）的加速，并提供了针对 Transformers、SGLang、vLLM 及 Apple Silicon (MLX) 的集成支持，旨在实现高质量且低延迟的并行文
aiSummary.summary_en: DFlash is a lightweight block diffusion model for speculative decoding, enabling efficient, high‑quality parallel drafting across various LLMs.
aiSummary.useCase: 用于加速大语言模型（LLM）推理性能，通过投机采样技术实现更快的文本生成速度。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Accelerate inference of large language models by adding speculative decoding with block diffusion.

repos.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程

aiSummary.summary: 项目聚焦大模型开发全流程，结合教程与公益教材，助力AI教育与研究。
aiSummary.summary_en: Free, Jupyter‑based tutorial series teaching LLM fine‑tuning, deployment, prompting, safety, and multimodal skills, updated with new topics and a Huawei Ascend version.
aiSummary.useCase: 快速入门大模型，支持教学与科研
aiSummary.useCase_en: Educate students and developers on practical LLM engineering through hands‑on notebooks and scripts.
